title: Internship Opportunity : WHO Collaborating Centre Activities, Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission
bodyHtml:
Shape your career in public health and global health initiatives through the IPC-WHO Collaborating Centre Internship Programme.

Gain hands-on experience in evidence generation, scientific writing, public health advocacy, and regional capacity-building activities. Work on emerging public health concerns and contribute to initiatives supporting countries across the South-East Asia Region.

📍 Apply today to strengthen public health systems, knowledge generation, and health workforce capacity in the region.

Click here to apply: https://forms.gle/EmndioB9ECfKASyh6 (opens in a new tab)
